rationale: The cancellation is covered under section 2, reason 3 of the wording: the county notice confirms your home was made uninhabitable by the June 14 tornado, and you filed well within the 90-day window in section 11. Payout is worked as section 10 of the wording sets out: the three prepaid, non-refundable trip costs total $2,440, less the $200 airline credit the supplier gave you, giving $2,240 — no deductible applies to this benefit and the plan's trip cost cap of $2,800 is not reached. Because the payout is above $1,000, a claims handler must sign off the calculation before payment is released (manual section 3).
